usedFor: “When a meeting recap is created” in Calendly files a document in Dropbox.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting recap is created” in Calendly, then “Upload File to Dropbox”
bestTemplate.why: A recap exists after the meeting, when notes or deliverables are ready to file.

watchOut: “When a contact is deleted” also reaches “Upload File to Dropbox”, which is rarely what you want.
